terminalProposition: There exists a support-stratified Schur composition law that handles fixed Ward null spaces, rank-changing hydrodynamic supports and domain-wall resolvent poles without illegal inversion, while preserving every compatible declared symmetry and decoration or emitting an explicit loss/refusal receipt.

scope.reason: A narrow theorem-sized strike can distinguish the competing singularity handlers before operator-theoretic generalization.

layers.claim: Composition must be a typed partial operation, not an everywhere-defined inverse formula.
layers.frontier: Choose the minimal categorical form of the partial operation.

layers.claim: Each stratum requires its own existence and positivity hypotheses.
Local Schur laws must glue across patches or explicitly retain singular modes.
layers.frontier: Determine whether Whitney strata are necessary or constant-rank semianalytic patches suffice.

layers.claim: Preservation is checked symmetry by symmetry; common Herglotz carriage is not itself a physical symmetry.
layers.frontier: Classify decoration transport under nontrivial bundle holonomy and antiunitary actions.

layers.claim: Elimination is physical only when the removed sector is unobserved and range-compatible on the declared regime.
layers.frontier: Specify preparation and measurement contracts for each domain.

layers.claim: The implementation must choose support-pseudoinverse, ordinary inverse, residue, patch change, retention or refusal from explicit diagnostics.
layers.frontier: Set numerically stable tolerances without turning exact rank into an arbitrary convention.

layers.claim: A finite executable witness motivates but does not prove the general theorem.
layers.frontier: Supply a written theorem and proof with independently reproduced adversarial examples.

layers.claim: Passing calculations may advance the proposal to review but cannot admit a scientific claim automatically.
layers.frontier: Connect the docket to an admitted Claimipedia Triage submission operation.

scope.closedWorld: All transformations acting on the declared finite-dimensional block-response inputs in this strike must be classified in the records below; unclassified physical or operator-theoretic symmetries remain outside scope and are listed as frontiers.

lightningStrike.conditional: IF one support-stratified Schur law covers the three bounded singularity families, THEN every link below must close without changing layers silently.
lightningStrike.completionRule: Every necessary link must close independently. Failure breaks the terminal proposition at that link while preserving upstream theorems and useful handlers.

links.necessary: Specify a common formal carrier without identifying the physical meanings.
links.closes: All three examples instantiate the same block type and retain distinct decorations.
links.falsifier: One example requires operations not representable without erasing a load-bearing observable.

links.necessary: List every in-scope action and its preservation or obstruction law.
links.closes: Independent audit finds no undeclared in-scope symmetry and every record has an executable or theorem-level test.
links.falsifier: A required symmetry changes the handler classification or cannot be expressed by the current decoration type.

links.necessary: Separate regular, fixed-null, pole and rank-change loci with explicit overlap rules while retaining the actions that preserve or exchange them.
links.closes: Every point in the bounded family receives a stable stratum or an explicit unclassified receipt, and every in-scope symmetry has a declared action on the strata.
links.falsifier: Path-dependent or accumulating singularities defeat the proposed finite stratification, or a symmetry maps a point to an unclassified locus.

links.necessary: Dispatch to ordinary inverse, support inverse, retention, residue, patch change or refusal.
links.closes: The handler is total as a decision procedure over the bounded input contract and never performs an illegal inverse.
links.falsifier: An input satisfies the contract but receives either multiple incompatible handlers or none.

links.necessary: Prove upper-half-plane analyticity and positive imaginary part for each composing handler.
links.closes: Each handler has a theorem or explicit refusal; residue outputs have positive operator weight.
links.falsifier: A permitted handler produces negative spectral weight or a nonanalytic output.

links.necessary: Prove overlap covariance and specify what happens around nontrivial loops.
links.closes: Outputs agree under transition maps and any holonomy is retained as decoration.
links.falsifier: Two lawful patch sequences yield inequivalent physical responses with no recorded obstruction.

links.necessary: Transport KMS, Ward and wall/index decorations when compatible and declare exact losses otherwise.
links.closes: A preservation theorem or incompatibility receipt exists for every declared decoration pair.
links.falsifier: The only common law works by forgetting all domain decorations.

links.necessary: Recover fixed Ward support, hydrodynamic rank change and wall-pole behavior as non-equivalent cases.
links.closes: Each exemplar passes its positive case and fails its adversarial neighboring case.
links.falsifier: The law conflates a pole with a null quotient or permits inversion at a rank change.

links.necessary: Separate theorem, witness, conjecture, counterexample and implementation claims.
links.closes: Independent review can reproduce each artifact and the Claimipedia packet retains all authority boundaries.
links.falsifier: A result cannot be traced to an exact hypothesis, source or executable receipt.

whatItCloses: ordinary inverse away from singular loci

landscape: one dispatcher vocabulary covers three singularity families
poles and rank changes are not the same as fixed null quotients
retention and refusal are lawful outputs rather than failures
closure: decoration-preserving law remains the hardest gate

nextDiscriminant: Prove the finite-dimensional local theorem for a block matrix-valued Herglotz family with a constant-rank eliminated support and range-compatible coupling, then construct the smallest transverse rank-change counterexample showing why that theorem cannot be extended through the singular locus by continuity alone.
stopTrigger: If two admissible approaches to the same singular point yield inequivalent external responses after all declared transition and residue data are included, stop claiming a single global composition law and split D-02 into stratum-specific calculi connected only by explicit comparison morphisms.
reentry: A canonical groupoid, dilation or measure-valued construction that removes the path dependence would reopen the unified-law branch.
